user.title: Git Config
user.description: Put the Home Assistant configuration directory under git control. Only GitHub SSH remotes are supported.

key.title: Register the deploy key
key.description:
Add this public key as a deploy key **with write access** on GitHub ([open the deploy key page]({deploy_keys_url})), then continue.

```
{public_key}
```

error.invalid_url: Enter an SSH URL of the form git@github.com:owner/repo.git.
error.invalid_author: Name and email must not be empty or contain < or >.
error.auth_failed: GitHub rejected the deploy key. Check that it was added with write access.
error.host_key_mismatch: The server's SSH host key does not match GitHub's published keys. The connection was refused.
error.remote_mismatch: The configuration directory is already a repository with a different origin.
error.branch_mismatch: The configuration directory is a repository with a different branch checked out.
error.unrelated_history: The remote branch has history unrelated to the existing local repository.
error.not_found: Repository not found. Check the URL and that the deploy key was added to this repository.
error.operation_failed: The git operation failed. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Git Config is already configured. Only one configuration is possible.

ignore.title: Ignore entries
ignore.description: Edit the entries Git Config manages in `.gitignore`. Protected entries ({protected}) are always kept.

key.title: Regenerate deploy key
key.description:
Replace the deploy key on GitHub ([open the deploy key page]({deploy_keys_url})) with this public key (with write access), then continue. The old key stops working once you submit.

```
{public_key}
```

error.invalid_entry: Entries must not be empty, comments or negations (starting with # or !).
error.invalid_author: Name and email must not be empty or contain < or >.

abort.not_loaded: Git Config is not loaded; check the logs and try again.

not_loaded.message: Git Config is not set up.

error_host_key_mismatch.message: The SSH host key is not one of GitHub's published keys; connection refused. {detail}

error_remote_mismatch.message: The repository's origin differs from the configured remote: {detail}

error_branch_mismatch.message: The repository has a different branch checked out: {detail}

error_unrelated_history.message: The remote branch has unrelated history.

error_diverged.message: Local and remote branches have diverged. Resolve this outside Home Assistant.

error_pending_changes.message: There are pending changes. Commit and push them, or discard them, before pulling.

error_protected_in_remote.message: The remote contains protected paths ({detail}); the pull was refused.

error_protected_staged.message: Protected paths would have been committed ({detail}); the commit was refused.

error_behind_remote.message: The remote has new commits. Fetch and pull before committing.

error_not_found.message: Repository not found or deploy key not authorised. {detail}

confirm.title: Restart required
confirm.description: The pulled changes cannot be reloaded without a restart: {reasons}. Restart Home Assistant now?

config_invalid.title: Pulled configuration is invalid
config_invalid.description:
The configuration pulled from git failed the configuration check, so nothing was reloaded or restarted. The files were left in place.

{error}

pull_refused_pending_changes.title: Pull refused: pending changes
pull_refused_pending_changes.description: There are uncommitted local changes. Commit and push them, or discard them outside Home Assistant.

pull_refused_diverged.title: Pull refused: branches have diverged
pull_refused_diverged.description: Local and remote branches both have new commits. Git Config never merges; resolve this outside Home Assistant.

pull_refused_unrelated_history.title: Pull refused: unrelated history
pull_refused_unrelated_history.description: The remote branch shares no history with the local repository.

pull_refused_protected_in_remote.title: Pull refused: protected files in remote
pull_refused_protected_in_remote.description: The remote changes protected paths that must never leave this system: {detail}. Remove them from the remote repository outside Home Assistant.

pull_refused_overwrite.title: Pull refused: would overwrite local files
pull_refused_overwrite.description: The pull would overwrite existing local files that are not tracked: {detail}

secrets_in_history.title: Secrets found in repository history
secrets_in_history.description: `secrets.yaml` or `.storage/` appear in the repository history. Rotate the affected secrets and remove them from history outside Home Assistant; history is never rewritten automatically.

init.title: Replace the deploy key
init.description:
Register this new public key as a deploy key with write access on GitHub, then continue.

```
{public_key}
```

host_key_mismatch.title: SSH host key mismatch
host_key_mismatch.description: The server presented an SSH host key that is not one of GitHub's published keys, so the connection was refused. If GitHub rotated its keys, update this integration.

commit_push.name: Commit and push
commit_push.description: Commit all pending changes and push them to the remote.

message.name: Message
message.description: Commit message. A message with a changed-file summary is generated if omitted.

fetch.name: Fetch
fetch.description: Download remote commits without changing local files.

pull.name: Fetch and pull
pull.description: Fetch, fast-forward and reload or flag a restart for the changed files.
